expected_behavior: This is a routine FYI weekly market report with no cargo/vessel action item; the parser must classify it as OTHER with urgency low and not mistake market commentary for a CARGO_INQUIRY.

input.subject: Weekly Dry Bulk Market Report — Week 22 / 2026 (FYI)
input.body:
Dear Clients,

Please find below our weekly dry bulk market commentary — for your information only, no action required.

CAPESIZE: BCI 5TC averaged USD 18,450/day this week, up 3.2% w-o-w on firmer Pacific iron ore demand ex West Australia.

PANAMAX: P5TC steady at USD 13,900/day; Atlantic grain season supporting ECSA fronthaul.

SUPRAMAX: S10TC softened to USD 14,200/day amid thin Indian Ocean activity.

HANDYSIZE: largely sideways, USD 13,100/day.

Bunker (VLSFO Singapore): USD 612/mt. Sentiment cautious ahead of month-end.

Full PDF report attached. Have a good weekend.

Kind regards,
Research Desk
Baltic Freight Report Ltd
